english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically dirty or contaminating things, and it also appears in expressions such as 污糟錢 for corrupt money.
Use this for physically dirty things, and also for obscene or dirty language; it is the all-purpose choice for both.
This is the all-purpose choice for something dirty or splashed with mud; it does not specifically describe turbid water.
Use this when “lousy” describes a place or thing as dirty or untidy rather than generally poor in quality.
Use this specifically when “nasty” means physically dirty or filthy.

examples.english: The table is so dirty that it feels sticky.

examples.english: Your shoes are foul; take them off before coming inside.
